verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is BVNK's first-party marketing, which mentions a built-in rewards feature for idle balances and customer-facing rewards. Nothing in the pack documents its economics, eligibility, or regulatory caveats, and reserve composition and attestations are not addressed at all. missing for 10: reserve composition disclosure, attestation reports, rewards/yield rate and mechanics, eligibility criteria, plainly stated regulatory caveats, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the economics of held stablecoins are documented — reserve composition, attestations, and any yield or rewards program with its eligibility and regulatory caveats stated plainly

citations.quote: Put idle balances to work with built-in rewards.
